symptom: mendixlabs/mxcli#1510: lint QUAL002 reported import/export mappings, published REST services and data transformers as undocumented (45 findings on one project), and nothing in MDL could close them: a `/** … */` above `create or modify published rest service` was dropped with MDL089. Every published REST service was reported even when Studio Pro HAD documented it, and `create or modify` of a Studio Pro-documented mapping, published REST service or data transformer wrote an empty Documentation over the stored text.
cause: The four create statements' AST had no Documentation field, so storesDocumentation() reported the comment as detached and the visitor never read it. The executors never set the model's Documentation (the mapping writers wrote whatever the model held, i.e. ""; the data transformer writer wrote a literal ""; the published REST writer only carried the stored value via keepStoredTopLevel). model.PublishedRestService and model.DataTransformer had no Documentation, and the catalog builder wrote "" for published_rest_services.Documentation ("not stored on published REST").
file: mdl/ast/ast_import_export_mapping.go, mdl/ast/ast_rest.go, mdl/ast/ast_datatransformer.go, mdl/visitor/visitor_import_export_mapping.go, mdl/visitor/visitor_rest.go, mdl/visitor/visitor_datatransformer.go, mdl/executor/cmd_import_mappings.go, mdl/executor/cmd_export_mappings.go, mdl/executor/cmd_published_rest.go, mdl/executor/cmd_datatransformer.go, mdl/executor/documentation_carry.go, mdl/backend/modelsdk/published_rest_write.go, mdl/backend/modelsdk/integration_read.go, mdl/backend/modelsdk/data_transformer_write.go, mdl/catalog/builder_rest.go, model/types.go
fix: Documentation + DocumentationSet on the four statements, read with findDocComment; the executors set it and carry the stored value when no comment is written (carriedDocumentation, #1018); model + modelsdk read and write the top-level `Documentation` key for published REST services and data transformers (published REST drops it from the keep-stored list); describe prints it with writeDocumentDocComment (`--` lines when the text holds `*/`); the catalog stores the service's documentation. Java action parameter descriptions were already writable (#1588).
test: mdl/visitor TestIntegrationDocumentsReadDocComment_Issue1510; mdl/executor TestIntegrationDocumentation_Issue1510 (PedApp copy: stored key, describe round trip, carry, `/** */` clears) and TestIntegrationDocumentation_StudioProMappingKeepsIt_Issue1510; mdl/catalog TestPublishedRestServiceDocumentationReachesCatalog_Issue1510; the integration TestDocumentation_SurvivesRewrite gains the four doctypes. Revert check: without the fix every new test fails with the reported symptom; stubbing only the carry fails the rewrite and Studio Pro cases.
insight: Verify the BSON key against Mendix's own reader, not only modelsdk/gen: `mx dump-mpr --module-names=X` prints the model as Mendix deserialises it, so the doc comment appearing as the unit's `documentation` there (11.6.6 and 11.15) proves the key is the one Studio Pro reads. A QUAL002 finding nobody can close has two suspects, the writer and the catalog reader, and here both were broken: the catalog's hard-coded "" made the rule fire on Studio Pro-documented services too.
